title: US Military Directly Disables Vessel Attempting to Bypass Strait of Hormuz Blockade
detail: US military forces disabled a vessel attempting to bypass the Strait of Hormuz blockade, marking the first direct US kinetic action to enforce or contest the blockade regime. The intervention signals a significant escalation in US involvement in the ongoing Hormuz crisis and raises the stakes for both enforcement and circumvention of the blockade.

title: Iran Moves to Reassert Stranglehold Over Gulf Shipping After Bypass Routes Emerge
detail: CNN analysis reports Iran is actively working to reassert its stranglehold over Gulf shipping lanes after oil flows increasingly bypassed the Strait of Hormuz following the crisis peak. The move signals Tehran's intent to prevent long-term circumvention of its strategic leverage over global energy transit.
